item.title: Major highway project to revamp Horseheads' "Miracle Mile"
item.description: HORSEHEADS, N.Y. (WETM) — State route 14, or the "Miracle Mile" in Horseheads is projected to start a major highway project this summer. The New York State Department of Transportation will be milling and repaving the road and doing bridge construction. Village of Horseheads officials said the Miracle Mile will be completely milled and repaved. [...]

item.title: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka dies at 86
item.description: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka, whose career spanned over six decades with hits like “Breaking Up Is Hard to Do” and “Laughter in the Rain,” has died at age 86, according to a statement posted on his Instagram page.
